messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: sustained p95/p99 latency above SLO for service=runtime-inference-prod-west, p95=1.9s (target=0.8s), p99=4.3s (target=2.0s) · AutoPager: paging eng-oncall-west rotation · reason: latency_slo_burn
PagerDuty: Incident PD-9042 created · priority P1 · link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-9042
Samir: acked · I'll take first touch. pulling up recent deploys + autoscaler events.
Lina: I'm online, will help look at routing and model variants.
Samir: quick glance: traffic normal, but noisier tokenization CPU on sidecars + a recent autoscaler scaling policy change 03:12 UTC to scale-down threshold=2m. suspect scale thrash + tokenizer cold starts -> tail latency.
Jonah: we also saw an upstream spike from a customer test harness that sent many long-context requests; increased seq len distribution 4x. that might push some requests to heavyweight code path.
Priya: can we pause scale-down to keep buffers warm? and temporarily limit max-seq to 2048 for non-enterprise clients while we stabilize?
OpsLead: good call. Samir, can you flip the autoscaler to conservative mode. Lina, do routing clamp to divert enterprise-only traffic to dedicated pool.
Samir: running: \n```\nredwoodctl autoscaler update --pool prod-west --scale-down-delay 600 --reason "incident PD-9042: prevent thrash"\n```\nSamir: applied, new scale-down delay 10m. will take effect immediately.
Lina: restricting routing for non-enterprise: \n```\nredwoodctl routing update --service runtime-inference-prod-west --route "if customer_tier!=enterprise then max_seq=2048" --dry-run=false\n```\nLina: routing change rolled. enterprise traffic still full-length, non-enterprise clipped. initial p95 dropped to 1.4s, p99 still ~3.1s.
PagerDuty: PD-9042 acknowledged by Samir at 03:18 UTC · escalation level 1
Jonah: I can see sidecar CPU on a subset of nodes spiking with tokenization tasks. suspect recent tokenizer optimization reverted in canary deploy at 02:55.
Priya: can we roll back the tokenizer change on canary -> general? if canary changed behavior that explains wide tail.
Samir: identifying canary hosts: \n```\nredwoodctl deploy list --service runtime-inference-prod-west --since 02:30
# found deploy dpl-9921 (tokenizer tweak) at 02:55\n```\nSamir: initiating rollback: \n```\nredwoodctl deploy rollback --deploy dpl-9921 --service runtime-inference-prod-west --reason "rollback tokenizer tweak due to latency regression"\n```\nLina: while rollback runs, I'll temporarily disable speculative batching to reduce large batched requests causing long queue delays: \n```\nredwoodctl config set runtime.speculative_batching=false --service runtime-inference-prod-west\n```\nJonah: rollback completed on 6/6 nodes (~40s). speculative batching disabled. see immediate queue length drop.
Priya: monitoring customer-facing dashboards. CS-Eng, any inbound reports?
CS-Eng: received two tickets from enterprise customers reporting intermittent slow responses ~03:13-03:20 UTC, escalated. sent an initial update.
OpsLead: good. keep CS looped and prepare a short status communication. tagging postmortem owner now.
Samir: metrics: p95 0.95s, p99 1.6s after rollback + autoscaler hold + routing clamp · still watch for recurrence for 15m.
Priya: setting incident objective: restore p99 < 2.0s for 15 consecutive minutes before closing. assigning follow-ups: RDW-4380 (investigate autoscaler policy change), RDW-4381 (tokenizer revert verification tests), RDW-4382 (speculative batching safety limit).
Lina: logs show a small subset of requests still hitting heavy model variant due to a mis-tagged header from the test harness. I'll patch routing heuristics to ignore the harness header.
Jonah: patch applied, harness traffic no longer misrouted.
PagerDuty: PD-9042 status: monitoring · next escalation at 03:45 UTC if not resolved
Samir: adding a temporary synthetic warm traffic to keep tokenizer caches hot: \n```\npython infra/synth_load.py --target runtime-inference-prod-west --qps 150 --seq-dist heavy --duration 600\n```\nCS-Eng: sent customer follow-up update: "We detected increased latency for a subset of requests, mitigations (autoscaler hold, rollback, routing clamp) applied. Monitoring closely; will send final root cause after postmortem."
OpsLead: good comms. reminder: do not call this an RCA yet. follow-up postmortem must confirm root cause.
Priya: 15m window met, p99 stabilized ~1.2s for 20m. preparing to close incident. final checklist: add timeline, list mitigations, attach logs.
PagerDuty: PD-9042 closed by Samir at 03:44 UTC
IncidentBot: Runbook pointer: https://confluence.example/runbooks/autopager-latency · postmortem ticket created RDW-4380 · postmortem owner: Samir
Priya: quick lessons: 1) autoscaler aggressive scale-down + a canary tokenizer change combined to create tail pressure 2) speculative batching amplifies the tail when seq distribution spikes 3) need better canary for tokenizer (A/B perf test). scheduling wartime retrospective tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
OpsLead: nice quick ops. open items: RDW-4380, RDW-4381, RDW-4382 assigned. I'll draft an incident summary for execs.
